name: review-buddy
description: AI-assisted narrative code review — Prologue + risk-rated Chapters over a real git diff, reviewed in your browser. Claude Code plugin + MCP server for Cursor, VS Code Copilot, and Codex.
author: Zied Ben Haj Salah

scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run build:dist
scripts.verify:dist-fresh: git add --intent-to-add -- src/ui/dist dist && git diff --exit-code -- src/ui/dist dist
scripts.verify:prompts-fresh: bun run gen:prompts && git add --intent-to-add -- integrations && git diff --exit-code -- integrations
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:ui && bun run test:ui
scripts.verify:ci: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run build:ui && bun run build:dist && bun run test:ui && bun run verify:dist-fresh && bun run verify:prompts-fresh
